excerpts.text: Visiting Angels Home Care offers trusted and compassionate home care assistance and elder care services in Union County, NJ, Essex County, NJ, and the surrounding areas. Our unparalleled standard of non medical in home care ensures that your senior will be well looked after by qualified home care providers. With our multi step screening process, you can be sure that our staff has the right training and expertise to take excellent care of your loved ones.

Our home caregivers offer compassionate and attentive services so that your loved ones receive the highest caliber of elderly home care at all times. Whether you are in need of Alzheimer's in home care services, home health care, or general elderly home care, we offer the caring approach your loved one can benefit from.

At Visiting Angels Home Care, we recognize how challenging day to day life can be for your senior loved one. That is why we strive to offer the best home care services including assistance with activities of daily living. We can assist your senior with bathing, grooming, dressing, personal hygiene, meal preparation, medication reminders, and more.

Our home caregivers are available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week to offer care for Alzheimer’s patients, dementia care, post surgical care, and respite care.. Contact one of the area’s most trusted senior home care agencies by calling us at (908) 497-7016 today.

In home care services from Visiting Angels Union NJ are valued by seniors because of the flexible nature of our care plans. At Visiting Angels Union NJ, we customize each and every home care plan so you are sure to get the help you need. Whether you are looking for someone to help provide respite care or a caregiver to support you with memory care services, the home care professionals from Visiting Angels Union NJ can help.
